review.description: Adopt reconnectable host-backed view, incremental status and bounded history in S1-S3.
review.implementation: Reviewed Factory polling, host bridge calls, snapshot cursor acquisition and RunEvents pagination. No direct iframe localhost request or credential-bearing UI transport was added.
review.tests: Assembled test asserts absence of forbidden direct network requests; reopening preserves attention; lifecycle fixture asserts transcript has more pages. Concurrent cursor ordering, large diff pagination, visibility timing and soak remain explicit gaps.
